Emma / Rishi — attached technical notes. Below is the shortlist and quick rationale + ballpark monthly token projection for the volume you shared. Numbers are intentionally conservative for capacity planning.

Model shortlist (initial):
1) Llama2-13B (q8_0) — Pros: low cost, solid summarization after instruction tuning; Cons: struggles with >16k context unless using extended-window variant. Best for short routes and cheap baseline.
2) RedVicuna-33B-32k (float16 / 16k native) — Pros: native extended context, strong summarization for clinical notes; Cons: higher cost, needs dedicated GPU pools for p95 targets.
3) RedOpt-7B-int8 (quantized) — Pros: very low cost per-token, fast; Cons: lower factuality on complex clinical passages; useful as a fallback + embeddings pipeline.

Projected token math (Q1 launch month estimate):
- Assume 30k requests/day average = 900k requests/month.
- Avg input + output per request = 420 tokens => ~378M tokens/month.
- Long-context requests (12%) average 5.5k tokens => 59.4M tokens from long-context subset; remaining 318.6M tokens are short/medium.

Capacity notes: to meet p95 < 400ms for short requests we recommend mixing the following runtime configuration:
- Small route: Llama2-13B-q8 in shared hosted pool with aggressive batching (target batch 32, latency SLO 350ms).
- Long-context route: RedVicuna-33B-32k on dedicated capacity with KV cache warm-up and pinning for active sessions; horizontal sharding for throughput.
- Fallbacks: RedOpt-7B-int8 for low-priority background tasks / bulk summarization (cost savings).

Rough cost tiers (illustrative):
- Baseline (hosted-heavy, minimal dedicated): ~$35–45k/month (token dependent).
- Mixed (dedicated long-context + hosted short): ~$70–95k/month.
- Dedicated (all routes pinned & reserved): $120k+/month.

Attachments: kori_technical_notes.pdf contains latency assumptions, kernel choices by hardware, and a worked example for traffic shaping. I've also populated the spreadsheet you sent with the token calc and a nodal capacity sketch — see 'Kori_token_profile.csv' references.
